product_one_liner.value: Octopus Deploy is a continuous delivery platform for software and platform engineering teams to automate deployments, orchestrate releases, and run operational tasks across cloud, Kubernetes, and on-premises environments.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 300 employees; the company careers page reports 300+.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering posts include Senior Software Engineer Luke Butters’s explanation of Redis-backed multi-node Polling Tentacles (2026-10-21) and founder/developer Paul Stovell’s explanation of Octopus’s SQL Server document-store implementation (2016-03-24).

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board contains five entries: three regional expressions-of-interest listings and two Revenue Systems Specialist listings; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The AI Assistant documentation explicitly names Azure OpenAI; the Generative AI section of the GDPR page names OpenAI and Anthropic.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022, and separately claims GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights dates the latest round to January 1, 2024. Reporting published in October 2025 confirms the $30 million investment was secured in 2024 before the Codefresh acquisition; October 2025 is the report date, not the financing date.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified financing occurred in 2024, before the 2025-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The five current board entries are regional expressions of interest and Revenue Systems Specialist roles, not SDR, BDR, or Account Executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Octopus Feature Flags launched in public preview on 2026-07-13, inside the 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Chief Revenue Officer Harsh Sabikhi announced his departure on 2026-06-05, within the requested 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Revenue Systems Specialist posting says IT Operations owns HubSpot and the revenue stack and is migrating from Salesforce to HubSpot.
